name: @repo/svg-clip-mask
description: Reveals any children through a custom SVG shape mask that can morph on a loop, on scroll, or on hover.

useCases: Blob-shaped image or video frames with an ambient morph loop
Section dividers revealed through a diamond or wave mask
Hover cards that morph shape on interaction
compositionHints: Wrap an or gradient div as children for a shaped media frame
Feed matching-structure paths via morphPaths for smooth custom morphs
